name: Ibrahim ibn Adham
contribution: One of the most prominent of the early Sufi saints known for his zuhd.
legacy: The story of his conversion is one of the most celebrated in Sufi legend, mentioned in the Tazkirat al-Awliya of Attar of Nishapur.

checks.lead: Ibrahim ibn Adham (Arabic: إبراهيم بن أدهم); also called Ibrahim al-Balkhi and Ebrahim-e Adham (Persian: ابراهیم ادهم); c. 718 – c. 782 / AH c. 100 – c. 165 is one of the most prominent of the early Sufi saints known for his zuhd (asceticism).
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
